# First light over the harbour

We lit the lantern for the first time this winter. **Everyone** came down to the pier.

## What we learned

- Oil burns cleaner than wax
- The [tide table](/guides/tides/) matters more than the weather
- Bring a flask

```js
const lantern = "on";
// ## not a heading
```

> Keep the flame low on windy nights.
